caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, high-necked garment resembling a Victorian-era overdress or jacket, shown on a headless and footless mannequin form. The main garment is composed of blue and white vertical stripes, featuring a scalloped trim along the front opening, the lower hem, and the edges of the sleeves. The front is fastened with a row of round buttons running down the center. There are ruffled details following the line of the buttons and additional ruffles at the ends of the sleeves. The lower part of the dress is longer in the back, forming a trailing effect, and is shorter in the front, clearly revealing an underskirt or petticoat area that is plain and lacks decoration. In the upper right corner of the image is a smaller, monochrome line drawing that shows the back view of the garment, displaying the drape of the fabric, the high collar, and the overall shape. The background is a plain, light beige color. The illustration is rendered in fine, delicate lines, and the blue and white coloring is subtle and consistent throughout the striped fabric.
title: Wrapper
